notes: SMS sender header format is <operator/circle prefix>-<BRAND>-<suffix>, e.g. AX-KOTAKB-S. Only the BRAND identifies the institution; prefix and suffix vary per message.
Seeded ONLY from headers actually observed in the owner's inbox. Unknown brands are never guessed: the app asks once and stores the mapping.
One institution can use several brands (CUB: CUBLTD and CUBANK).
muted: brands whose messages the owner does not want. They are ignored before parsing and their bodies are not stored.
